name: should_side_render
describe: Per-face visibility test (boolean): early-return true if the block's bounding box does not reach the face (minY>0/maxY<1/minZ>0/maxZ<1/minX>0/maxX<1 by side), otherwise !neighbor.doesSideBlockRendering. Only blocks using the BASE Block impl are sampled (overrides excluded). Golden captured live from real Minecraft via NetheriteMod 'capture_shouldsiderender'.
